fusions.name: Both Roads Covered
fusions.desc: Looses 2 bolts at once along diverging paths, each dealing 9 damage and knocking the target back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Held at the Split
fusions.desc: A two-pronged thrust that deals 20 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Dead End Raised
fusions.desc: Raises a wall 6 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds that blocks the way through.

fusions.name: Second Prong
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
